payload.question: Proposal: the turn's end is driven by what the turn changed, and each reader gets only their next step. The agent gets exactly one next action: 'run these covering tests' when code it edited has no fresh run; 'this file belongs to no requirement, propose one' when it edited untraced code; 'repin or relink these links' when it moved code; the judge's questions, grouped by principle, when they block its next task; nothing when the turn edited nothing (an answer, a chat, a read). You get one line only when something needs you: a regression on behaviour you confirmed, a merge that waits, or a question; otherwise only the status line moves. Inside an intent loop the band shows the step and nothing else is printed. Plain-text, no cards, nothing repeated once said in the session. Does this match what you mean by smarter?
